parsed.title: Favorite Message Saving Fallback
parsed.oneLiner: Watch a quick game partner session to sample favorite message saving for 24 hours.
parsed.trigger: After dismissing the account signup wall on the Favorite messages screen.
parsed.eligibility: Guest users who dismiss the account signup wall (m6).

offer.title: Try Saving for 24h
offer.body: Not ready to sign up? Play a 15-second game with Luzia to try saving favorite messages for 24 hours.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Access is a time-boxed sample for guests who already declined signup; it does not grant permanent account access (r2) or bypass signup permanently.

kpis.primary: Conversion rate from ad-engagement to account signup
kpis.holdout: 5% user-level holdout for 30 days comparing total account creation and engagement rates

risks: Ad-supported access might delay signups if users find the temporary sample sufficient for short-term needs.

evidence.quote: Sign up to start saving your favorite messages. It's quick, easy, and free!

newElements.change: Add 'Try for 24h' rewarded button after the user declines the signup wall.

storyboard.caption: Guest users are blocked by a mandatory signup wall when trying to save messages.
Users who dismiss the signup wall see a fallback offer to sample the feature.
The user opts in to a 15-second rewarded game to unlock temporary access.
The user engages in the rewarded mini-game with Luzia as the Game Partner.
On verification, the user receives a 24-hour sample of favorite message saving.
